description.value: The Forslund-Watson Conservation Land Complex is an 80-acre nature reserve in south Langley, BC, managed by the Langley Field Naturalists. The reserve is an active habitat restoration site where volunteers plant native trees and shrubs, remove invasive species, and maintain old-field habitat for raptors and other wildlife. Whether the reserve is open for general public visitation — and what access or facilities may exist — is not described anywhere on the organization's website.

The website provides no information about public visitor access, trails open to visitors, or any cycling or visitor amenities. None of the required or optional amenity criteria can be confirmed from the available evidence.
